PAGE STRATEGY

Useful pages before more pages.

These parts give the visitor information they can use and give the site a coherent structure.

Clear offer

Explain the service, audience and location without vague claims or repeated keywords.

Relevant proof

Show real work, process and details that help someone evaluate the fit.

Easy contact

Make phone, email or WhatsApp available at the point a visitor is ready to act.

A CLOSER LOOK

Make the content worth visiting.

A portfolio should show a selected set of work with context: the brief, the decisions and what shipped. A concise resume and visible contact route help a prospective client understand both capability and fit.

A successful page should explain a genuine offer, answer common questions and point to real work. If your project has different requirements, the structure should change with them.
